formula: flights that left at most 15 minutes late / flights that left
why: Share of clients whose flight left on time. A flight that leaves early counts as on time.

formula: mean and median of dep_delay (minutes, negative = early) over flights that left
why: The typical wait: the median shows the usual flight, the average shows the pain of the few very late ones.

formula: scheduled flights with no departure time / scheduled flights
why: A cancelled flight is the worst outcome for a client: it needs rebooking.

formula: flights that left more than 60 minutes late / flights that left
why: Long delays break connections and trigger complaints.

formula: (flights that left more than 15 minutes late + cancelled flights) / scheduled flights
why: The one number the agency wants to keep low; it is what the first prediction predicts.
